title: Since Russia's 2014 annexation of Crimea, Norway has tried to tighten its control of Svalbard
text:
An intense line of snow will be moving through over the next hour bringing heavy snow that may reduce visibility to one-half mile or less along with wind gusts up to 40 mph. Expect changes in weather and road conditions. Motorists are urged to use caution if traveling through the area.
There are no outward signs of jitters, at least not yet: people in Svalbard are going about their daily lives as normal despite speculation that this Norwegian archipelago could be the next Arctic territory coveted by the United States or Russia.
